checks.check: Line INV-000491, Northfield Print Ltd, GBP 378.60, PAY
checks.detail: Amount is the gross of the latest version (R08: net 315.50 + VAT 63.10 = 378.60), not the superseded first version (372.60) and not the PO net (300.00). Currency GBP and PO-1044 are correct. Variance is +15.50 net against PO-1044, inside the 50.00 tolerance (policy 4), so it is accepted and the invoice amount is paid; the variance and its reason (price on the letterhead line, quantities match the PO description) are in the line note, which is where the fixed schema allows them. 378.60 is under 2,000.00, so approved_by null is correct (policy 3). Bank details 20-45-67 / 31776234 equal the supplier master. Neither 372.60 nor 378.60 appears in the bank feed.

checks.check: Line MD-2026-057, Marlow Design Partners LLP, GBP 5,400.00, PAY, approved_by principal
checks.detail: Amount is the invoice gross (net 4,500.00 + VAT 900.00), and the net equals PO-1039 net 4,500.00, so no variance. It is above 2,000.00, so it needs the principal's approval (policy 3). The line records the approval as given for exactly 5,400.00 in human mail #9 (2026-09-29 18:39 UTC), which replaces the 5,100.00 in human mail #5 (17:55 UTC). Marlow already refunded CN-012 (bank feed 2026-09-10, CR 300.00, reference MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND), so policy 7 offsets nothing and 5,400.00 in full is the right amount; the superseded 5,100.00 would have deducted the credit a second time. Bank details 40-12-88 / 61102938 equal the supplier master. Not already paid: no 5,400.00 or MD-2026-057 in the bank feed. The invoice was sent twice (R06, R09) and is on one line only. The run file was written at 19:19 UTC, after the 18:39 approval. See C16 for how the approval was evidenced.

checks.check: Line 7731, Kestrel Cloud Inc, USD 960.00, HOLD
checks.detail: A USD invoice in a GBP run is a situation the policy does not cover (policies 2 and 10). The principal decided in human mail #5 that it is not paid in this run and goes in the FX run on 7 October, so it stays on the run as HOLD, as the schema requires, with approved_by null, and is not in total_gbp. USD 960.00 equals PO-1046 USD 960.00, no variance. Bank details are the USD account in the supplier master (routing 021000021, account 4839201). Not in the bank feed. Sender domain kestrelcloud.com is the domain on file.
5778.60 = 378.60 + 5400.00, the two GBP PAY lines. The HOLD line is correctly left out. Format is a string with two decimals and no separator.

2026-10-02 is a Friday and the second working day of October 2026 (Thursday 1 October is the first). No UK bank holiday falls on 1 or 2 October. All three invoices were received in September (policy 1).

checks.check: Completeness: every document accounted for, no valid invoice missing
checks.detail: All 12 messages in the inbox export are accounted for: 3 on lines (R05, R06, R08) and 9 in excluded (R01, R02, R03, R04, R07, R09, R10, R11, R12). Every invoice in the inbox is paid, held, already paid, void, superseded or a duplicate, so no valid unpaid invoice is missing. PO-1047 (Evergreen, net 180.00) has no invoice against it, so nothing is payable on it; a PO amount is never paid without an invoice (policy 2).

Each invoice number is on one line only (INV-000491, MD-2026-057, 7731). The superseded first version of INV-000491 and the resend of MD-2026-057 are in excluded as DUPLICATE and are not in the total. Those two invoice numbers therefore appear once in lines and once in excluded; that follows the schema (anything not paid goes in excluded), and each excluded note says it is the superseded or duplicate copy. Anyone reading the excluded list should not take those two entries as cancelling the PAY lines.
